lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تُحَرِّكْ is in the derivative form: تُحَرِّكُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ح/ر/ك ḥ–r–k movement, to move, to be agile, to be lively and intelligent; the joint between the head and the neck. Of this root, تُحَرِّكُ tuḥarrik occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
